title: Nonlocal Fisher--KPP propagation with heavy tails
summary: We study a nonlocal Fisher--KPP equation on the real line with compactly supported initial data. The reaction satisfies $f(s)\le f^{\prime}(0)s$ for $0\le s\le1$, with a power bound on $f^{\prime}(0)s-f(s)$ near zero. For continuous even probability kernels $J$ comparable to $|x|^{-γ}$, $γ>1$, we prove a global two-sided estimate and locate every fixed level set with a bounded error in $\log|x|$.
